key_points: Nvidia selected Jacobs to deploy its Omniverse-based digital twin platform at a large-scale U.S. AI research and development facility.
Nvidia announced a record $150 billion share buyback program.
Nvidia was highlighted as a winner at Trump’s AI lunch, suggesting policy support for AI.
Insider transactions show mixed activity with notable buys from Privium Fund Management (48,200 shares) and Plato Investment Management (7,589 shares).
Some analysts caution that Nvidia’s valuation remains elevated relative to its AI growth prospects.
